name: coach-moves
why: Five moves of a strong human coach working with a player at this level, as the coaching video the README cites shows them, in the routine's own words and inside its video grammar: ask before telling, name the habit and connect it to the rule that replaces it, follow the better move to the opponent's best reply, pitch each miss at the player's level, praise by what a move saw.

daily.after: - the video binds every board to its game and ply, speaks at most one number on a stats or chart scene, and carries `say` and a `caption` on every beat.
